mapper.sql: select p.log_id, p.practice_date, p.dept_id, p.group_id, p.student_id, p.subject_id, p.book_name, p.page_from, p.page_to, p.question_text, p.finish_status, p.difficulty_note, p.self_correct_rate, p.hardest_question, p.duration_min, p.submit_slot, p.submit_by_student_id, p.proxy_flag, p.confirm_status, p.confirm_time, p.client_type, p.device_code, p.spot_status, p.spot_by, p.spot_time, p.spot_remark, p.status, p.create_time, p.update_time, p.remark, s.student_name, s.student_no, d.dept_name, g.group_name, sub.subject_name, sb.student_name as submit_by_name, (select string_agg(k.knowledge_name, '、' order by pk.id) from spas_practice_log_knowledge pk left join spas_knowledge k on k.knowledge_id = pk.knowledge_id where pk.log_id = p.log_id) as knowledge_names from spas_practice_log p left join spas_student s on s.student_id = p.student_id left join spas_student sb on sb.student_id = p.submit_by_student_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = p.dept_id left join spas_study_group g on g.group_id = p.group_id left join spas_subject sub on sub.subject_id = p.subject_id
mapper.insert: insert into spas_practice_log( practice_date, dept_id, group_id, student_id, subject_id, book_name, page_from, page_to, question_text, finish_status, difficulty_note, self_correct_rate, hardest_question, duration_min, submit_slot, submit_by_student_id, proxy_flag, confirm_status, client_type, device_code, spot_status, status, create_time, remark ) values ( #{practiceDate}, #{deptId}, #{groupId}, #{studentId}, #{subjectId}, #{bookName}, #{pageFrom}, #{pageTo}, #{questionText}, #{finishStatus}, #{difficultyNote}, #{selfCorrectRate}, #{hardestQuestion}, #{durationMin}, coalesce(#{submitSlot}, '0'), #{submitByStudentId}, coalesce(#{proxyFlag}, '0'), coalesce(#{confirmStatus}, '0'), #{clientType}, #{deviceCode}, coalesce(#{spotStatus}, '0'), coalesce(#{status}, '0'), now(), #{remark} )
mapper.update:
update spas_practice_log
book_name = #{bookName}, page_from = #{pageFrom}, page_to = #{pageTo}, question_text = #{questionText}, finish_status = #{finishStatus}, difficulty_note = #{difficultyNote}, self_correct_rate = #{selfCorrectRate}, hardest_question = #{hardestQuestion}, duration_min = #{durationMin}, remark = #{remark}, update_time = now()
where log_id = #{logId} and status = '0'
update spas_practice_log set status = '1', update_time = now() where log_id = #{logId}
mapper.insert: insert into spas_practice_log_knowledge(log_id, knowledge_id, is_primary) values (#{logId}, #{knowledgeId}, coalesce(#{isPrimary}, '0'))
mapper.select: select pk.id, pk.log_id, pk.knowledge_id, pk.is_primary, k.knowledge_name from spas_practice_log_knowledge pk left join spas_knowledge k on k.knowledge_id = pk.knowledge_id where pk.log_id = #{logId}
mapper.insert: insert into spas_practice_book_stat(dept_id, subject_id, book_name, use_count, last_used) values (#{deptId}, #{subjectId}, #{bookName}, 1, now()) on conflict (dept_id, subject_id, book_name) do update set use_count = spas_practice_book_stat.use_count + 1, last_used = now()
mapper.select: where p.status = '0' and p.student_id = #{studentId} and p.practice_date = #{practiceDate} order by p.create_time desc

select s.student_id as "studentId", s.student_no as "studentNo", s.student_name as "studentName", m.role_in_group as "roleInGroup", case when exists ( select 1 from spas_practice_log p where p.student_id = s.student_id and p.practice_date = #{practiceDate} and p.status = '0' ) then true else false end as "submitted" from spas_study_group_member m inner join spas_student s on s.student_id = m.student_id where m.group_id = #{groupId} and m.leave_time is null order by m.role_in_group desc, s.student_no

select s.student_id as "studentId", s.student_no as "studentNo", s.student_name as "studentName", g.group_id as "groupId", g.group_name as "groupName" from spas_student s left join spas_study_group_member m on m.student_id = s.student_id and m.leave_time is null left join spas_study_group g on g.group_id = m.group_id and g.status = '0' and g.dept_id = s.dept_id
and g.subject_id = #{subjectId} and (g.subject_id is null or g.group_id is null)
where s.del_flag = '0' and s.status = '0' and s.dept_id = #{deptId} and not exists ( select 1 from spas_practice_log p where p.student_id = s.student_id and p.practice_date = #{practiceDate} and p.status = '0' and p.subject_id = #{subjectId} ) order by g.group_name nulls last, s.student_no

select p.log_id as "logId", p.student_id as "studentId", s.student_no as "studentNo", s.student_name as "studentName", p.difficulty_note as "difficultyNote", p.book_name as "bookName", p.question_text as "questionText", (select string_agg(k.knowledge_name, '、') from spas_practice_log_knowledge pk left join spas_knowledge k on k.knowledge_id = pk.knowledge_id where pk.log_id = p.log_id) as "knowledgeNames" from spas_practice_log p left join spas_student s on s.student_id = p.student_id where p.status = '0' and p.finish_status = '3' and p.practice_date = #{practiceDate} and p.dept_id = #{deptId} and p.subject_id = #{subjectId} order by p.create_time desc
mapper.update: update spas_practice_log set spot_status = #{spotStatus}, spot_by = #{spotBy}, spot_time = now(), spot_remark = #{spotRemark}, update_time = now() where log_id = #{logId}
mapper.insert: insert into spas_kiosk_device(device_code, device_name, dept_id, status, last_seen, last_student_id, app_version, create_time, update_time) values (#{deviceCode}, #{deviceName}, #{deptId}, '0', now(), #{lastStudentId}, #{appVersion}, now(), now()) on conflict (device_code) do update set device_name = coalesce(excluded.device_name, spas_kiosk_device.device_name), dept_id = coalesce(excluded.dept_id, spas_kiosk_device.dept_id), last_seen = now(), last_student_id = coalesce(excluded.last_student_id, spas_kiosk_device.last_student_id), app_version = coalesce(excluded.app_version, spas_kiosk_device.app_version), update_time = now()
mapper.select: select s.student_id as "studentId", s.student_no as "studentNo", s.student_name as "studentName", count(distinct pk.knowledge_id) as "stillWeakCount", string_agg(distinct k.knowledge_name, '、') as "knowledgeNames" from spas_practice_log p join spas_practice_log_knowledge pk on pk.log_id = p.log_id join spas_student_knowledge_stat sk on sk.student_id = p.student_id and sk.knowledge_id = pk.knowledge_id join spas_knowledge k on k.knowledge_id = pk.knowledge_id join spas_student s on s.student_id = p.student_id where p.status = '0' and p.dept_id = #{deptId} and p.practice_date between #{beginDate} and #{endDate} and coalesce(sk.weighted_rate, sk.avg_rate, 1) < #{weakRate} and p.subject_id = #{subjectId} group by s.student_id, s.student_no, s.student_name having count(distinct pk.knowledge_id) >= 1 order by count(distinct pk.knowledge_id) desc, s.student_no
mapper.update: update spas_practice_log set confirm_status = #{confirmStatus}, confirm_time = now(), update_time = now(), status = case when #{confirmStatus} = '3' then '1' else status end where log_id = #{logId} and status = '0' and proxy_flag = '1' and confirm_status = '1'
